### Historical audit — S0027

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2/results/r2/fixed_h0/H0/development/commons_129095630/trajectory.jsonl`. Only chunk 2 is available; the reference and render images themselves are not visible to this audit.

| Evidence | Observed operations and results |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, JSONL line 17, characters [0,192194) | The instructed goal was to reconstruct an indoor photograph with separate meshes and matching camera and framing. The student’s **interpretation**, not independently verified scene content, was an antique tool workshop. Programs specified a bench and drawers, stool, neighboring furniture, tools, cans, cup and carousel; procedural wood and metal finishes; positioned component meshes; and an angled camera with two area lights. Intended connections, poses, occlusions and materials cannot be verified geometrically from code or names alone. |
| Same event, embedded step 1 result | The first build failed with an `AttributeError` because `world` was `None`. The next complete program created a world when absent and also changed scene details and naming. This is an observed response to runner feedback, not teacher advice. |
| Same event, embedded step 2 result and third program | Step 2 timed out after approximately 600 seconds without diagnostic stdout or stderr. The student then reduced modeled detail, replaced the cup’s many wall elements with one shell, and reduced Cycles samples from 48 to 16 with denoising. These changes are consistent with a performance remedy, but the timeout’s cause is unestablished. The camera remained at the same specified position and target. |
| Same event, embedded step 3 result | The runner reported `ok: true`, completed 16 samples, and saved `final.png` and `scene.blend`. This establishes **technical build/render success**, not visual fidelity, correct part connections, pose, lighting, framing, or material match. No executions remained. |
| Student `codex_session`, line 18, characters [0,3331); `model_response`, line 19, characters [0,340) | The final session was supplied both reference and render image paths, recorded zero tool calls, and returned `DONE`. The response does not describe a comparison or independently validate the result. |

**Teacher and exploration:** No teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, receipt, or adoption is visible in this chunk. The student autonomously revised complete programs in response to execution feedback; no separate tool-based exploration is recorded in the final session. Unseen chunks might contain additional events, but their contents cannot be inferred.

**Outcome and lessons:** This was not an empty patch: substantial scene programs were executed. The first attempt had a concrete runtime failure, the second a technical interruption, and the third a formally successful render; overall reconstruction correctness remains **unknown**. Transferably, explicit initialization and a lower-cost retry can overcome observed execution barriers, though the specific cause of the timeout remains a hypothesis. The particular workshop objects and camera settings are task-specific choices, not validated lessons. Whether the render matches the unseen photograph—including object multiplicity, textures, connected parts, pose, camera and illumination—remains unresolved.
